I will plant this plot using the seed I saved from last year's harvest because improved seeds are too expensive and hard to find in our market. I was able to get two bags of NPK fertilizer through the government program, so I will spread that on the field, and I will also add cow manure because we keep some livestock at home. My family and I will do all the clearing, planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves since the plot is small, and we cannot afford to hire extra hands. We rely entirely on the June rains, so I will not irrigate, and I have no money for chemicals — I will pull the weeds by hand.
